hook: A community can build a name together while one owner retains the power to sell its future.
readerPromise: Understand a brand as shared institutional power and explore what meaningful decentralization would require.
protectedRevelations: Detailed proposed legal and constitutional arrangements
visualPlan: Keep several contributors connected to one recognizable name, with the decision point visibly separate.
Use a guild mark and contemporary shared identity as distinct historical moments.
Reduce governance choreography to one rule change and one possible exit, without suggesting that a vote resolves ownership.
End with the shared promise still between autonomous participants and the reader’s book.

authorReview.scope: Complete eight-sentence script checked against canonical short-reader opening evidence for premise, clear identity, specific interest and protected revelations.
authorReview.targetDuration: About one minute at an unhurried conversational pace with real pauses; measure after recording.
authorReview.emotion: Concrete recognition, thoughtful tension and open curiosity; no melodramatic mystery or inflated promise.
authorReview.audioConversion: Blocked until all batch scripts pass independent editorial review.
authorReview.visualExecution: The existing art is preserved as working material; book-specific changes above still require implementation before film validation.

independentReview.notes: Every spoken sentence reviewed against canonical English short reader for clear newcomer meaning, source grounding, curiosity and emotional intent. Replaced abstract promotional commentary with concrete viewer-facing language. All eight sentences have a distinct intended response and explicit restrained TTS direction; fictional later outcomes remain withheld. This is editorial review, not audience testing or rendered-audio approval.

sentenceIntentions.text: A community can build a name together while one owner retains the power to sell its future.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Show jointly created value under one owner's control
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel the stakes of shared identity becoming private power

sentenceIntentions.text: Decentralised Brands asks whether the people who build that identity could also share control over its future.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the possibility of a different constitutional arrangement
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand this is about governance of a name

sentenceIntentions.text: The book begins with brands as promises that let strangers trust something beyond a single person.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Explain brands through promises among strangers

sentenceIntentions.text: From guild marks to digital platforms, a name can carry memory, belonging, and practical dependence.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Give historical and digital forms of enduring identity
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: See continuity across guilds and platforms

sentenceIntentions.text: That makes control over the name more consequential than a question of logos or marketing.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Connect name control with real dependence
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand why logo design is not the central issue

sentenceIntentions.text: The inquiry explores who can change the rules, remove members, preserve records, and make leaving possible.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Ask who can change membership and the rules

sentenceIntentions.text: Communities and platforms look different when you ask who can decide what their shared name becomes.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Relate the inquiry to communities the viewer helps build
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel a personal stake in distributed contribution

sentenceIntentions.text: Start with the promise behind the name, then follow the power to decide what it becomes.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Follow the promise toward decision-making power
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to inspect who owns its future
